## Failure Detail

**`property`** (verbatim):
```
test_prop_factorial_strictly_exceeds_n
```

**`shrunk_input`** (verbatim):
```
test_prop_factorial_strictly_exceeds_n(
    n=1,
)
```

**`exception`** (verbatim):
```
AssertionError: assert 1 > 1
```

---

## Interpretation

The shrunk input `n=1` is the **minimal integer** at which the invariant `factorial(n) > n` breaks: `factorial(1) == 1`, which is equal to — not strictly greater than — `n`, so the strict inequality is false at the smallest non-trivial fixed point of the factorial function. (Hypothesis also noted `n=2` in the docstring, but `n=1` is the smaller counterexample the shrinker settled on.)
